//freezeAt: Clock the app sees. Its date part must equal the newest workDay in the fixture, or the Today tab stops saying 'Today'. Capture aborts if they drift apart.
//locales: One shot per screen. Add "de" back to also render the German set.
//devices: CSS size x scale = the pixel size the store gets. Portrait only. One device = one shot per screen; the other store sizes are listed in SKILL.md, paste one back to add it.
